typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		LTSS_CC_Primary_Key as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		Care_Coordinator_First_Name as string,
		Care_Coordinator_Last_Name as string,
		Care_Coordinator_ID as string,
		Begin_Date_for_Care_Coordinator as string,
		End_Date_for_Care_Coordinator as string,
		Interaction_Type as string,
		Assessment_Date as string,
		Date_PCSP_Held as string,
		Reason_for_PCSP as string,
		Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Member as string,
		PCSP_Signed_by_Provider_Indicator as string,
		Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Provider as string,
		Cost_of_Plan_of_Care as string,
		IDD_County_of_Service as string,
		Domain_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  LTSS_CC_Primary_Key  ,Medicaid_ID  ,Care_Coordinator_First_Name  ,Care_Coordinator_Last_Name  ,Care_Coordinator_ID  ,Begin_Date_for_Care_Coordinator  ,End_Date_for_Care_Coordinator  ,Interaction_Type  ,Assessment_Date  ,Date_PCSP_Held  ,Reason_for_PCSP  ,Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Member  ,PCSP_Signed_by_Provider_Indicator  ,Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Provider  ,Cost_of_Plan_of_Care  ,IDD_County_of_Service  ,Domain_ID  FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.KANCARE_LTSM_EXTRACT ORDER BY Medicaid_ID, Assessment_Date',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableKANCARELTSMEXTRACT
SourceTableKANCARELTSMEXTRACT split(iifNull(LTSS_CC_Primary_Key,'') == '',iifNull(LTSS_CC_Primary_Key,'') != '', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(MissingDomainID,DomainIDPresent,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@MissingDomainID derive({} = {}) ~> PlaceHolderMissingDomainIDRowsCount
ConditionalSplit@DomainIDPresent derive() ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount
PlaceHolderMissingDomainIDRowsCount sink(input(
		Missing_Domain_ID_In_Xwalk as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Missing_Domain_ID_In_Xwalk = Domain_ID)) ~> TargetMissingDomainIDinXwalkFile
PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount sink(input(
		Care_Coordinator_ID as string,
		LTSS_CC_Primary_Key as string,
		Interaction_Type as string,
		Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Provider as string,
		Begin_Date_for_Care_Coordinator as string,
		IDD_County_of_Service as string,
		Care_Coordinator_Last_Name as string,
		Reason_for_PCSP as string,
		Assessment_Date as string,
		Date_PCSP_Held as string,
		Care_Coordinator_First_Name as string,
		Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Member as string,
		End_Date_for_Care_Coordinator as string,
		PCSP_Signed_by_Provider_Indicator as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		Cost_of_Plan_of_Care as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Care_Coordinator_ID,
		LTSS_CC_Primary_Key,
		Interaction_Type,
		Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Provider,
		Begin_Date_for_Care_Coordinator,
		IDD_County_of_Service,
		Care_Coordinator_Last_Name,
		Reason_for_PCSP,
		Assessment_Date,
		Date_PCSP_Held,
		Care_Coordinator_First_Name,
		Date_PCSP_Signed_by_Member,
		End_Date_for_Care_Coordinator,
		PCSP_Signed_by_Provider_Indicator,
		Medicaid_ID,
		Cost_of_Plan_of_Care)) ~> TargetKanCareLTSMFile
